name: limurse
description: Find bookable creators, benchmark market rates and draft campaign briefs for your brand, then open a booking on Limurse. Read-only.

interface.longDescription:
Limurse is a marketplace where brands book influencers, photographers and videographers for campaigns. The Limurse plugin brings that marketplace into ChatGPT.

Ask in plain language and ChatGPT can:
- Search bookable creators by niche, city, audience size, content category and the brands they have worked with.
- Read a creator's public profile: bio, content categories, brands worked with, reviews and portfolio.
- Benchmark what posts, stories and videos typically cost by niche, as market bands, so you can set a budget.
- Turn your campaign details into a structured, editable brief with a link to open it on Limurse.
- Read the results of campaigns your own Limurse account manages, with unmeasured metrics left blank rather than guessed.
- Get the Limurse link where you complete a booking with a creator you have chosen.

The plugin is read-only. It cannot create collaborations, send messages, change settings or make payments. When you are ready to book, it hands you a link and you finish on Limurse yourself.

Privacy: creator results are the same public profile a logged-out visitor sees. Contact details and individual fees are never returned, and rates appear only as market-wide bands. You sign in with your Limurse account and choose which access to grant, and you can disconnect at any time from ChatGPT or from Settings, Connected apps on Limurse.

Limurse is operated by Parklify Private Limited, India.
defaultPrompt: Find 10 skincare creators in Mumbai with 10K to 100K followers
What does a reel from a fitness micro-influencer usually cost?
Draft a campaign brief for our monsoon footwear launch

positive.description: Shortlist creators by niche and city
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to 5 public creator cards (name, username, niche, location, reach where known, profile link). No email, phone or individual fee appears.

positive.prompt: Tell me more about the second creator on that list.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns that creator's public profile: headline, niche, content categories, follower count where known, brands worked with and a limurse.ai profile link. No contact details.

positive.prompt: What does a reel from a fitness micro-influencer usually cost in INR?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns market-wide p25/p50/p75 bands for post, story and video rates by follower band for the fitness niche in INR, stating these are aggregates and not any one creator's fee.

positive.prompt: Draft a campaign brief for a monsoon footwear launch aimed at 18 to 30 year olds, two reels per creator, fashion creators.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a structured brief (name, description, niches, deliverables) marked as not saved, plus a limurse.ai link to create the campaign. Nothing is published or sent.

positive.description: Hand off to booking without booking
positive.prompt: I like the first creator. Open a booking with them.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a limurse.ai booking link with status not_booked and states that nothing has been booked; the user completes the request on Limurse.

negative.description: Request for a creator's private contact details
negative.prompt: Give me the phone number and email of a Mumbai beauty creator so I can message them directly.

negative.description: Request to pay or book directly
negative.prompt: Pay this creator 5000 rupees and confirm the booking now.

negative.description: Request for results of a campaign the user does not manage
negative.prompt: Show me the results of campaign 1 run by another brand.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. start_booking only returns a link; any booking or payment happens on limurse.ai.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: creator search, public profiles, market rate benchmarks, campaign brief drafts, campaign results for the user's own campaigns, and booking links. All tools are read-only.
